SELECT /* LGVPAY00027.retrieveAllowanceMappingList */ am.seq_value , am.subsidiary_code , am.grade_name , am.allowance_id , cvn.detail_desc as allowance_name , am.last_update_date , l.user_name FROM TB_PAY_VAR_ALLOWACE_MAPPING_N am,lgcom_user_m l, tb_pay_calc_var_n cvn WHERE am.allowance_id = cvn.payroll_calc_variable_id and am.last_update_user_id = l.application_user_id
AND am.allowance_id = #{allowanceName}
AND am.grade_name like '%' || UPPER(#{gradeName}) || '%'
ORDER BY am.seq_value
SELECT /* LGVPAY00027.retrievegAllowanceMappingId */ sq_PAY_VAR_ALLOWACE_MAPPING_N.nextval AS seq_value FROM dual
SELECT /* LGVPAY00027.retrievegAllowanceMappingDuplicate */ * FROM TB_PAY_VAR_ALLOWACE_MAPPING_N am WHERE am.grade_name like '%' || UPPER(#{gradeName}) || '%'
SELECT /* LGVPAY00027.retrievegAllowanceMappingDuplicateUpdate */ * FROM TB_PAY_VAR_ALLOWACE_MAPPING_N am WHERE am.grade_name like '%' || UPPER(#{gradeName}) || '%' AND am.seq_value != #{seqValue}

SELECT /* LGVPAY00027.retrievegAllowanceId */ cvn.payroll_calc_variable_id as allowance_id FROM tb_pay_calc_var_n cvn where to_char(cvn.payroll_calc_variable_id) = #{allowanceName} or cvn.detail_desc = #{allowanceName}
